source.finalCandidate: Record descendant commit after this contract is committed; no fabricated or self-referential SHA.

ownerAndExecutor.owner: Development head; DevOps prepares and qualifies the exact operation bundle.
ownerAndExecutor.authorizedCaller: Company owner or company orchestrator in a valid current running job, for task 69 and the bound installation only.
ownerAndExecutor.requiredExecutor: Current installation's trusted deployment maintainer runs one approved hash-pinned bundle in existing updater service context.
ownerAndExecutor.existingResources: Compose updater defines Docker socket, server directory and control mounts. Source proves mounts, not current agent access or a callable operation.
ownerAndExecutor.newCapabilityRequired: Invoke only this fixed operation for bound installation/task; no caller command, SQL, DSN, path, container or executable.
rights: Resolve updater's configured Compose project/server directory and current app/db containers.
Inspect only those containers' identity/startup/configuration internally; never return raw inspect/environment.
Execute only reviewed reader in current app and fixed read-only identity/fingerprint probe in actual Compose db.
Write private evidence in existing control volume and read updater request/status.
No grants, migrations, DB writes, installer invocation, restart, deletion or generic host command.
ownerAndExecutor.authorizationRequired: Preserve existing current-job/orchestrator and company-person scope checks; bind task, agent, company and installation before resolving resources. Ordinary employee/node key, foreign company, ended job and unrelated task refuse. New adapter must implement/test this; contract provides none.

readPointsInOrder: Authenticate and bind task/installation before any service inspection.
Require agreed quiet window, zero working jobs, no pending request or waiting/running update, and exclusion of concurrent update/config writers.
Resolve actual app/db from updater's configured project; reject foreign project, extra overrides, external target or ambiguous mapping.

Privately bind current app container/image/revision, process start identity, command and deployed main/config/client module hashes. Proposed fixed startup reads inside the current app: /proc/1/environ, /proc/1/stat and /proc/1/cmdline, compared with private container startup configuration and exact image/module hashes. Require PID 1 to be the standard Node entry without injected preload or alternate config path. Unavailable or denied reads refuse; nothing raw is returned.

Verify exact deployed source constructs running app DB from anchored startup config without later rebinding. Compare effective startup and reader settings via private keyed fingerprint. A second loadConfig, label or container environment alone is insufficient.
Use deployed loadConfig/openPool for separate diagnostic connection with verified effective config and existing internal service credentials. Never import main/CLI or call createDb/migrate.

Run fixed bounded READ ONLY identity and incident metadata fingerprint probes on app target and actual Compose db used by pg_dump. Require physical target mapping, database/cluster identity and data fingerprints equal. Unknown identity or insufficient permission refuses without a grant.
Re-read process/config/image identity after probes; refuse drift. Roll back read transactions, release clients and close only diagnostic Pool on every path.

Preserve private Compose/env and safe update/job evidence. Verify target and previous installer compatibility with preserved DB/config. Require independent backup/restore/recovery proof before preflight success.
Persist safe receipt separately from request/status. Revalidate bound facts immediately before controlled workflow may dispatch.

fixedProbeContract.databaseMode: Bounded READ ONLY transactions; no SQL input, migrations, arbitrary functions or persistent DB mutation.
fixedProbeContract.identity: Private database/cluster identity plus actual app-to-Compose service/volume/endpoint mapping. Unavailable/ambiguous identity refuses; equal database names or cloned data alone are insufficient.
fixedProbeContract.data: Approved incident window, task 44 allowlisted metadata projection, count and deterministic ordered digest on both targets. No prompt/result/tail/token/env columns returned. Do not hash volatile sessions into an equality claim during active work.

limits.onLimit: Refuse; no partial digest/success. Task 44 uses 40 rows plus one overflow sentinel. Narrow incident window in a reviewed subsequent operation if needed.

fixedProbeContract.errors: Permission, connection, query, timeout and identity errors map to fixed refusal codes. No driver error, stack, cause, parameters, environment or DSN serialization.

persistPoint.root: Existing control volume, fixed private release-preflight subdirectory resolved by trusted executor.
persistPoint.names: Executor-generated receipt ID; directory 0700/files 0600; no caller path/symlink traversal; ownership stays in trusted service context.
persistPoint.safeReceipt: Allowlisted decision/reason, receipt ID, UTC, source references, opaque keyed config/target/data fingerprints, counts and safe receipt hash.
persistPoint.privateEvidence: Current Compose/env recovery copy and fingerprint key stay in private service directory. No raw config/archive, credentials or unkeyed secret-bearing config digest reaches agents.

output.onRefusal: Only applicable fixed reason and safe actually observed fields; no invented IDs, hashes or counts.

dispatchBoundary.placement: Before orchestrator update_hornhoof and before updates/routes.ts send()/UpdaterControl.request() creates this rollout's request.
dispatchBoundary.requiredBehavior: Any refusal/missing receipt stops workflow with no request. Receipt creation alone is insufficient. No pre-existing pending request.
dispatchBoundary.raceLimit: No global fence or atomic expected-SHA comparison. Head excludes other update/config writers through revalidation and dispatch.
dispatchBoundary.oldUpdaterBeforeDispatch: No delivered request means this operation invokes no old backup/installer/rollback. Existing outer-placement fixture proves condition only in isolation.
dispatchBoundary.oldUpdaterAfterDispatch: Unchanged; may run previous installer and replace Compose/env. Refuse unknown/incompatible previous/target config and untested recovery before dispatch.

recovery.automaticPrevious: Current app revision/env pin; initially bd696b0 without task 44, not independently selected recovery artifact.
recovery.healthyOldRoute: Second controlled update_hornhoof to approved immutable recovery semver, then full health/config/data/API acceptance.
recovery.unavailableOldRoute: Stop. Require approved bounded maintainer restore and private config/backup; no generic agent exec or CEO technical commands.

qualificationRequiredNotExecuted: Wrong/unknown/external DB, startup/reader config mismatch and drift refuse before dispatch.
Permission denial, timeout, row/byte limit and evidence persistence failure refuse without secret output.
Foreign company, employee/node key, ended job and unrelated task refuse before service/DB reads.
Refusal creates no request, invokes no old updater, changes no Compose/env/DB and overwrites no evidence.
Control old-source negative fixture, then prove actual implemented pre-dispatch guard. Placement-only fixture is not implementation proof.
Private storage ownership, no-secret output with logging sentinels, timeout/cleanup and read-only transaction assertions.
Actual deployment anchor/DB/config/backup proof and selected recovery test after isolated fixtures.
minimalRuntimeBlocker: No verified bounded service executor supplies running-app anchor and app/Compose comparison with enforced refusal before dispatch. Head must name/authorize this fixed executor for implementation/qualification; no generic host access or new platform.
